default/30978.htm.text: Holy Ark: A decrepit old chest. As you approach you feel the magic emanating from within it and also a sense of impending doom.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30978-01.html.text: Holy Ark: The key fits the lock on the chest perfectly. When the chest is opened, the key begins to glow red-hot and then melts away, burning your hand. Inside is a book with an old, faded cover.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30978-02.html.text: Holy Ark: The chest is locked tightly, as we were told. Someone else is here!

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30978-03.html.text: Holy Ark: The chest does not contain anything else.
